verdict.rationale: Cursor's agent is documented as a general-purpose coding agent that writes/reviews/modifies code (cursor-docs-22), reproduces issues and verifies fixes (cursor-docs-3), runs checks/inspects diffs (cursor-docs-4), and hooks can 'run formatters after edits' (cursor-docs-34), with Bugbot flagging code-quality issues (cursor-docs-38) — collectively implying it can write tests, fix lint issues, and do maintenance-style edits (cursor-docs-13 shows a changelog example of updating Node version constraints). However, no evidence explicitly documents automated merge-conflict resolution or a dedicated 'update dependencies' workflow as named capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of merge-conflict resolution, an explicit dependency-update/upgrade workflow, and a concrete first-party example of the agent writing a test suite end-to-end.
